exposure: Live-performed music therapy with physical contact (MT with PC)
cohort: The study enrolled parents of 99 preterm infants (50 in the MT group, 49 in the SC group) receiving care in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU).
finding: Live-performed music therapy with physical contact in preterm infants significantly reduced parental salivary cortisol levels and decreased perceived stress scores over 4 weeks compared to standard care.
